claims.text: Many reviewers report visible lash growth, thickness, or darkening within weeks of use.
Several reviewers complain the bottle is very small for the price.
Some users experienced eye irritation or stinging, especially if the serum got into the eyes.
Reviewers find the product easy to apply, often like an eyeliner.
A few reviewers saw no results or found it inferior to other products like Latisse.
